name: Tarima
description: Floral aromas with stone fruit, very expressive, balanced, and aromatic.

name: Shaya
description: Well balanced, complex with a distinct minerality which augments the abundance of fruit flavors.

name: Polvorete
description: Nice phenolic structure to the zesty, round palate. Medium to full body, with lemon zest, mineral and some oyster shells followed by a mouthwatering finish.

name: Inazio Urruzola
description: Intense aromas of citrus and white flowers, ripe tropical fruit on the base gives complexity and character.

name: Hacienda Arinzano Blanco
description: Notes of citrus fruits, such as lemon and orange peel, with nuances of exotic fruit, such as pear and mango. Long and balanced finish.

name: Mar de Frades
description: Aromas of stone fruits, like apricot, medlar fruit, along with almond flowers and subtle tropical salt notes. Has an elegant freshness and complexity.

name: Pazo Barrantes
description: Elegant, insinuating, perfumed, floral and subtle. Very vibrant, and it's fresh and with mandarin orange peel–infused acidity, with tropical hints of guava and pineapple flavors.

name: El Coto "Crianza"
description: Balanced with notes of raspberry, cherry, spice and toasted note that lead to a silky finish.

name: Finca Resalso
description: Ripe black cherry color with ripe red berry hints (mulberry and blackcurrant) intermingled with elegant, balsamic, oaky aromas.

name: Juan Gil Silver
description: Full bodied wine with dark cherry color and powerful aromas of red berries, toasted and smoked notes.

name: Termes
description: Balanced wine with blackberry, chocolate and walnut aromas, fruit-driven, with fine tannins.

name: Marqués de Murrieta "Reserva"
description: Concentrated and spicy with a hint of pepper in the nose. A generous yet polished red, still fresh, with plum, mineral, and coffee bean.

name: Juan Gil Blue
description: Purple/black in color, with nose of pain grillé, graphite, earth tones, spice box, black fruits, and a hint of balsamic, It opens in the glass to reveal savory flavors and a lengthy, pure finish.

name: Clio
description: Opaque purple color with an expressive nose of brier, mineral, blueberry and blackberry fruit leading to a plush, opulent wine with great density, savory flavors and a lengthy finish.

name: Emilio Moro
description: Blueberry and plum-cake character. Full, but quite supple tannins with blackberry and chocolaty oak on the palate and intense finish.

name: Hacienda Arinzano Rosé
description: Intense presence of red fruits with pronounced citric notes, flowers. Velvety, refined and elegant.
